👋 Welcome to the Electrix app

This is a working demo. Nothing here is real yet — try everything.

1. Pick your own name top-right. The app changes depending on who you are.

2. Do what you'd do in a real day: send a job, ask for material, punch in, book a meeting.

3. Tell Baruch what's missing, what's confusing, and what you'd never use.

The mic can't run in this preview — use the 🎤 key on your keyboard. Material photos ask once to allow Claude; say yes.

New job

GPS fence is set from the address automatically when you create the job. Anyone on site can fine-tune it with 'Set location here'.

📤 Take out

Snap it, pick the address, confirm. It comes off the garage list.

📥 Put back / came in

Snap the material, or the invoice / packing slip. It gets read and added to the garage.

📜 Material history

⚖️ Inventory check

Compares the actual garage count with the authoritative movement ledger. Differences are flagged for you to look into — nothing is changed automatically.
